🎙 US, Israel defeated in their wars against Iran: Hezbollah chief

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Hezbollah Secretary-General Sheikh Naim Qassem has praised the resilience of the Iranian nation, stressing that its steadfastness has led to the defeat of the United States and Israel in their wars against Iran.

“The United States and the Zionist regime were defeated in their three wars against the Islamic Republic of Iran because of the Iranian nation’s unity and steadfastness. This great nation was able to create a historic epic,” Sheikh Qassem said on Sunday during a speech marking Muslim Unity Week and the birth anniversary of the Prophet Mohammad (PBUH).
​
“As long as we stand firm and defend our rights, our land, and our freedom, they [the US and Israel] will never be able to achieve their plans and will never succeed,” he added.
​
The Hezbollah chief urged Muslim nations not to allow internal disputes to open a domestic front and distract them from their main enemy.
​
“Resistance and steadfastness come at a cost, but at the same time, they are the foundation of our position, strengthening our ability to achieve our goals and defeat the enemy’s project,” he said.
​
“No matter how much pressure the US and Israel exert, and no matter how severe the sanctions and military aggression may be, resistance will always neutralize the enemy’s plot,” Qassem further said.
​
He also reiterated that unity has been established in Lebanon among Hezbollah, the Amal Movement, and all political groups that oppose Israel and seek the liberation of occupied lands.

⚡️ Iran moves to establish joint free trade zone with Turkey in Khoy

📌 Khoy, IRNA – Iran has completed the necessary legal and administrative steps to establish a joint free trade zone with Turkey in Khoy, northwestern Iran, and is now awaiting further action from the Turkish side to advance and finalize the project, an Iranian official has said.

Hossein Forouzan, secretary of Iran’s Supreme Council of Free Trade-Industrial and Special Economic Zones, made the remarks during a visit to Khoy on Saturday, highlighting the city’s significant border, economic and transportation potential.
​
Forouzan said the proposed joint free zone has entered the legal process following negotiations between the two countries, adding that the Iranian government has also approved the project. He said implementation will proceed under a bilateral memorandum of understanding.
​
He emphasized the strategic importance of the Razi border crossing, describing it as a major route for trade between Iran and Turkey. He said developing the area’s supporting infrastructure and establishing a logistics hinterland are essential for expanding commercial activity.
​
During his visit, Forouzan reviewed plans for a 50-hectare site in Ivughli designated for customs facilities and a logistics hinterland. He also visited Khoy’s industrial and transportation facilities, including its airport.
​
The official said the proposed joint free zone would complement existing economic capacities in West Azarbaijan Province rather than weaken other free zones.
​
Khoy Governor Ali Alaei said the city’s road, rail, air and customs infrastructure provides strong potential for expanding economic exchanges with Turkey. He also highlighted the Razi border, Khoy airport and logistics facilities as key assets for regional development.

💬 Iranian officials congratulate U-17 boys’ national volleyball team on world championship

📌 Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, in separate messages, have congratulated Iran’s Under-17 Boys’ National Volleyball Team on winning the world championship.

President Pezeshkian expressed congratulations to the country’s national youth volleyball team, as well as its players, coaches, technical staff, their families, and the Iranian sports community, on their inspiring victory at the World Championships in Qatar.
​
“This brilliant victory is a manifestation of the talent, willpower, self-belief, and capabilities of the Iranian generation, who, whenever we trust them and provide them with opportunities to showcase their abilities, can achieve glory at the highest global level,” he said on Sunday.
​
Speaker Ghalibaf also expressed his congratulations, saying: “The glorious championship of Iran’s Under-17 Boys’ National Volleyball Team at the world championships and its decisive victory over France in the final once again raised the name of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the pinnacle of world volleyball and hoisted Iran’s flag over the Persian Gulf.”
​
“Iranian youth have proven that whenever knowledge and technical skills are combined with national pride, determination, and a champion’s spirit, no great arena is beyond their reach,” he added.
​
Ghalibaf appreciated the efforts of all those who contributed to the achievement and wished the Iranian volleyball players a bright and glorious future.
​
IRGC chief expresses congratulations
​
In a separate message, the Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps, Major General Ahmad Vahidi, congratulated Iran’s national youth volleyball team on winning the world championship/
​
He said that the players’ determination and relentless efforts, even amid the enemy’s intense psychological warfare, had once again brought the spirit of “We Can” to life.
